falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 swing low invalidates the 76% bottom pattern match, as that level held in the reference pattern; this would signal structural weakness inconsistent with a bottom formation and suggest a new downleg rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 41 implies moderate fear but not panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates a genuine fear event rather than the controlled capitulation typical of bottoms, breaking the pattern's volatility signature and suggesting forced selling/deleveraging continues

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 4,300
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals flight-to-safety with risk-off price action, invalidating the bottom thesis because it shows bonds and stocks positively correlating in stress (typical of recession scare/liquidity crisis) rather than the divergent stabilization pattern seen at August 2024's bottom where yields rose with equities
